    48	SpinelNCPInstance::vprocess_disabled(int event, va_list args)
    49	{
    50	        EH_BEGIN_SUB(&mSubPT);
    51	
    52	        while(!mEnabled) {
    53	                // If the association state is uninitialized, fail early.
    54	                if (get_ncp_state() == UNINITIALIZED) {
    55	                        syslog(LOG_NOTICE, "Cannot attempt to sleep until NCP is initialized.");
    56	                        EH_EXIT();
    57	                }
    58	
    59	                // Wait for any tasks or commands to complete.
    60	                EH_WAIT_UNTIL_WITH_TIMEOUT(
    61	                        NCP_DEFAULT_COMMAND_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT,
    62	                        mEnabled || !is_busy()
    63	                );
    64	
    65	                if (mEnabled) {
    66	                        break;
    67	                }
    68	
    69	                require(!is_initializing_ncp(), timeout_error);
    70	
    71	                reset_tasks(kWPANTUNDStatus_Canceled);
    72	
    73	                if ((get_ncp_state() != DEEP_SLEEP) && (get_ncp_state() != FAULT)) {
    74	                        start_new_task(boost::shared_ptr<SpinelNCPTask>(new SpinelNCPTaskDeepSleep(this, NilReturn())));
    75	
    76	                        EH_WAIT_UNTIL_WITH_TIMEOUT(
    77	                                NCP_DEFAULT_COMMAND_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT,
    78	                                (get_ncp_state() == DEEP_SLEEP) || mTaskQueue.empty()
    79	                        );
    80	                }
